subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When asked to list a work item's direct children — optionally filtered by state — the tracker shall return every item whose parent is the given item, across all states by default, through one implementation shared by the engine (port) and the human (CLI).
rationale: the parent→children direction must be directly queryable, not only reachable as the open-children rollup (FR-7) or by a hand scan; a completed epic must still surface its full task set, and the port and CLI must not diverge (FR-16)
fit_criterion: over a fixture corpus, a parent-scoped query returns exactly the given item's direct children in every state, byte-identical from the CLI and the port; a state filter narrows the set to the expected members; a parent with no children returns empty, not an error
